warrants.quote: This number does not include 9,385,000 shares of common stock issuable upon the exercise of pre-funded warrants outstanding as of May 5, 2025
In May 2018, the Company issued a warrant for 23,669 shares of the Company’s common stock to a service provider with an exercise price of $3.19 per share.
In December 2020, the Company issued a warrant for 30,000 shares of the Company’s common stock to a service provider with an exercise price of $18.00 per share.
